correctness.rationale: The family source supplies the canonical T(X) action, the 1080 nonfree points with cyclic order-three stabilizers, and the local system needed to transport the translation action on cohomology. Each nonidentity g has 27 fixed points in the torus model, and the same fixed count in the family. Each point has orbit size 27, yielding 40 singular orbits and one G-orbit of fixed points per order-three subgroup. The symplectic tangent action is linearizable and has no invariant vectors, so its spectrum is ζ,ζ,ζ²,ζ². There are no pseudoreflections, so the germs are singular; the determinant is one, both ages are two, and the small cyclic quotient is Q-factorial. Verbitsky's crepant-implies-symplectic and reflection-generation results exclude crepant resolution. The action fixes H² by definition and H³ by Kapfer–Menet and deformation, hence H⁵ and H⁶ by duality. In Lefschetz, the contribution outside H⁴ is 1+7−8−8+7+1=0, so the traces in degree four are 108 at identity and 27 otherwise. The character is the regular character plus 27 trivial characters and the average is 28. Rational quotient cohomology equals the invariants as Hodge structures. The injective symmetric square of H² already has dimension 28 and Hodge row (1,5,16,5,1). In the cover, the holomorphic symplectic form identifies Ω¹ with Ω³, so h^{3,1}=h^{1,1}=5; this and h^{4,0}=1 show that all noninvariants in H⁴ are (2,2). In degree three, h^{3,0}=0 and b₃=8 yield the two entries 4. The orbifold formula for a global quotient without a branch divisor adds one (uv)^2 for each of 80 nonidentity elements, since its fixed points form a single orbit; this exactly replaces the missing (2,2) cohomology in E. The ordinary and stringy Euler numbers are 28 and 108. The complement of the finite fixed set in the simply connected real eight-manifold is simply connected; its free quotient has π₁=G, and adjoining the singular points kills all stabilizers (which together contain all g), giving π₁(Y)=1. CHECK.py and the verification notes were inspected, not executed; abstract arithmetic cannot establish the geometric inputs. This is rational cohomology in the smooth complex family with its specified G, not an integral splitting or a claim about singular fibers.

value.rationale: This is the natural quotient by the family's canonical translations. Its ordinary and stringy cohomological accounting separates what the quotient loses from what its singular points replace. The exact equality of the stringy polynomial to that of the smooth cover, without a crepant resolution, plus the fundamental-group contrast between coarse space and smooth locus, is independently useful for identifying how much these invariants can and cannot detect. Value does not rest on dividing 1080 by the orbit size alone.
